episodic.note: expectedMessageIds are rows of the authoring machine's data/app.db; on another corpus the goldens cannot exist, so the dataset reports not-applicable instead of 0%.

semantic.note: expectedMemoryIds and expectedKeywords are quoted from the authoring machine's memories table.

preference.note: mustContain/mustNotContain are literal wordings of that corpus's preference rows.

graph.note: expectedNeighbours are relations the authoring machine's entity_edges holds, forbiddenNeighbours are pairs only its memory_links co-mentions; both are seeded by that corpus's memory ids.
